correctness.rationale: For every fixed d, Vandermonde superadditivity proves the binomial-index coin lower bound. A finite-depth greedy expansion proves the matching leading term with exponent (d-1)/d^2. Every residue modulo a has the exact Apéry envelope indexed by K=r+ja because gcd(a,b)=1. Both Frobenius and genus identities give the two claimed uniform asymptotics, including a=2 and all b>=1. The finite verifier was independently executed on 928 cases of two different exact Apéry algorithms; this is supporting evidence only and no infinite conclusion depends on it.

originality.rationale: The 2020 quadratic-source Theorems 8.1–8.4 give order-of-growth bounds, not the exact universal leading constants with a power-saving remainder or all d>=3. The 2023 repunit recurrence hypotheses and 2024 fixed-upper pure-binomial semigroups do not imply the mixed-binomial polynomial family. No identical or dominating statement was found by the recorded published searches or published-finding corpus semantic queries; surviving risk from unindexed results and one partly inaccessible broad-method paper is acknowledged.

value.rationale: The main 2020 quadratic-sequence paper identifies exact Frobenius/genus estimation and higher polynomial degrees as important open directions. The present result supplies two universal asymptotic constants (not merely crude orders), quantitative uniform remainders, and a structural all-fixed-degree theorem for a natural two-parameter infinite generator family. It is an invariant theorem about both gaps and largest nonrepresentable integers, not an artificial finite slice or a simple parameter renaming.
